name: Betni Kalk
statement:
I design and paint murals for public spaces to brighten the days of passersby via bright colors and subject matter that inspired from mural’s location. My murals usually include detailed imagery, patterns, and layered shapes. Many people can’t attend exhibitions
or visit art museums often, so murals are a great way for the public to enjoy art. As both a graphic designer and a painter, I enjoy the endless combinations of imagery I can get from combining traditional media and digital tools in the design process. I like the challenge of considering the design placement and scale for both pedestrians and drivers - for example, often for exterior murals - I want to include enough detail to remain interesting to pedestrians but the imagery should also be understood from a distance such as to drivers who are passing by it at a higher speed. I value the possibility of murals being backgrounds for photos/selfies. When the mural is in a climate with winter, the color reminds that spring is coming soon. I also do art consulting, facilitate mural projects, and mentor students and emerging artists through the mural process. When I’m not painting murals or
teaching design, I create artwork for exhibitions and commissions.
